Neobrutalism components

A shadcn/ui-based component set that names the style and turns it into copyable parts.

Context

The README calls it “a collection of neobrutalism-styled components based on shadcn/ui”, made “for people who want to learn more about neobrutalism style”. Documentation lives at neobrutalism.dev.

GitHub repository created 25 July 2023. It had about 5,500 stars on 2026-09-25, the most of any repository returned by a GitHub search for “neobrutalism”.

Released under the MIT License, copyright 2023 Samuel Breznjak (LICENSE).

Observed

  • Every card, input, calendar cell, and button has a solid black outline of roughly 2 px.
  • Cards and buttons cast solid black shadows offset down and to the right, with no blur.
  • Fills are flat: a pale blue page, white cards, and one saturated blue for primary buttons, the selected date, and the slider track.
  • Headings are a large, heavy geometric sans-serif; body text is black on white.
  • Corners are square or very slightly rounded. There are no gradients or transparency.

Why it belongs

A clean, restrained statement of the web-component grammar of the style: outline plus hard shadow on every surface, one bright accent. It is useful as a baseline because it has almost no illustration or decoration to distract from the system.

Borrow

Apply outline and shadow to the component primitives once, so that every composed layout inherits the style. Keep to a single accent color when the content is dense.
